resource: Ability proposals of one creature think (16 attack entries + 8 defence entries of its profile)
allocation_impact: Bounded at profile admission, so a think's proposal list holds at most 24 entries; a profile above it, or with two melee entries, is refused PROFILE_INVALID and admits nothing.
boundary_tests: max=24: a profile of 16 attacks and 8 defences is admitted
max+1: 17 attacks or 9 defences are refused PROFILE_INVALID
notes: CREATURE-AI-1 §1.2 and §1.3. Test: apps/game-server/src/ai_think/think_tests.rs profile_missing_and_invalid_profiles_are_refused. Registered by OTV2-20261004-creature-ai-1.
